name: Bilibili

disclosure.zh: 含 AI 生成内容时，在「创作声明」里勾选「该视频使用人工智能合成技术」。分区和「自制 / 转载」由你自己选，应用不会填写。封面会被裁成 16:10、4:3（手机首页）和 16:9：标题放在中间。
disclosure.en: For AI-generated content, tick "This video uses AI synthesis" under 创作声明 (creator declaration). The category (分区) and 自制 / 转载 (original / repost) are yours to choose; the app never fills them. The cover is cropped to 16:10, 4:3 (phone home feed) and 16:9: keep the headline in the middle.

guide.zh: 应用放入视频、标题、简介，并逐个输入标签（回车生成）；封面文件也会放入，裁剪框由你确认。然后选分区、自制/转载，检查后点「立即投稿」。
guide.en: The app adds the video, title, description and the tags one by one (Enter creates each); the cover file is set too - confirm its crop box yourself. Then choose the category and 自制 / 转载, check everything and press 立即投稿 (Submit) yourself.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written without a logged-in session, 2026-10): check them on the live 创作中心 page and set status to verified + lastVerified.
Tags: separate input, one Enter per tag (submit: enter); B站 allows <= 10 tags of <= 20 chars.
The 分区 picker and 自制 / 转载 radio are deliberately not in this adapter.
The open platform (openhome.bilibili.com) upload API needs a developer application and review; not used here.
